restoredContributions: The first restoration recovers the concrete explanation that incorporation can follow several coercive political routes while explicitly preserving uncertainty through ‘might’ and ‘remains unknown.’
The second restoration recovers the useful examples of geographically and temporally uneven implementation and burden; both claims remain conditional through ‘might.’

The third restoration recovers the key temporal distinction between conquest as a sudden concentration of force and administration as repeated arrival; ‘would depend’ correctly keeps the administrative claim hypothetical.
scope: Nonblind follow-up checking three restorations; no new literary score
